title: Read a JSON record
summary: ASP.NET Core: Read a JSON record. Send another title.
introduction: A record can describe body data. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON record with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Read a JSON record

blocks.text: The JSON body is bound to a Book record. Results.Json sends its Title in the web JSON naming style.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A type describes shape; add checks for values that must not be empty.
